name: desktop_automation
description: Open or reveal files inside registered source directories on the user's visible desktop. Prefer open_in_nexa for built-in file previews; opening a previewable file externally requires the user's explicit request and external_requested=true. HTTP(S) pages and searches belong to browser_session so the user and Agent share Nexa Browser.

external_requested.description: Set true only when the user explicitly requested opening the file in an external application. Otherwise use open_in_nexa for previewable files.

action.description: Desktop file action to perform. Both actions are limited to registered sources.

path.description: Absolute path or source-root relative path for open_path or reveal_path. Must resolve inside a registered source directory and the current source scope.

reason.description: Brief user-facing reason for the desktop file action.
